promised.summary: Management consistently meets guidance on retail store expansion, 5G capex tapering, and digital ARPU, with moderate variance in O2C margins due to global refining crack volatility.

promises.target: 300+ net new store additions in Q2 FY27
promises.quote: We expect store network expansion to maintain a quarterly run rate of over 300 net additions across priority consumption categories.
promises.actual: Added 342 net new stores across grocery, fashion and consumer electronics in Q2 FY27.

promises.target: Peak telecom capex completion by H1 FY27
promises.quote: Our pan-India 5G deployment is essentially complete, and capital expenditures in the connectivity business will taper significantly from H1.
promises.actual: Peak 5G capex finished; H1 FY27 connectivity capex moderated to ₹9,400 Cr.

promises.quote: Tariff repair combined with rising data usage per subscriber will drive sustainable ARPU progression beyond the 195 rupee threshold.
promises.actual: Achieved ARPU of ₹195.1 in Q1 FY27 and ₹197.8 in Q2 FY27.

promises.quote: Downstream chemical margins remain subdued, but integrated refinery configuration positions us to sustain robust fuel cracks.
promises.actual: Global refining margin compression softened transportation fuel cracks to 8.4%.

snapshot.description: Reliance Industries is India's largest private enterprise with market-leading positions spanning Energy (O2C refining & petrochemicals), Retail (18,000+ stores across grocery and electronics), and Digital Services (Jio with 480M+ 5G/4G subscribers).

cash.note: Substantial operating cash generation driven by Jio upfront cash collections and Retail inventory velocity.

targets.guidance: Operationalise solar PV & battery storage giga facilities by FY27
Drive 5G adoption to 200M+ users with JioAirFiber rollout

bull_points: Jio tariff hikes flow straight to operating profit with near-zero incremental capex.
Omnichannel retail leadership with unmatched private label penetration and scale advantage.
New Energy giga-complexes provide multi-decade green decarbonisation growth vector.
bear_points: Cyclical volatility in global petrochemical spreads and Chinese export dumping.
Elevated capital outlays in new energy could constrain near-term return on capital.
Consumer discretionary slowdown in tier-2 fashion and lifestyle retail.
